messages:
lee: Quick follow-up from the PM: recurring GPU headroom depletion and autoscaler thrash. We need owners + concrete short-term fixes and ETAs. Please keep replies short.

sam: TL;DR: short spikes (20	60s) aren't triggering scale or scheduler leasing fast enough; causes per-tenant queue pileups.

chi: Action A: Scheduler "fast-lease" path (30s leases + quick requeue). Owner: @chi. ETA: 2026-04-09. Acceptance: during 60s synthetic bursts, 95th queue depth <= baseline 75th.

olivia: Action B: Per-tenant soft cap at routing layer (toggleable). Owner: @olivia. ETA: 2026-04-02. Acceptance: no single tenant >45% reserved for >45s in tests.

marta: Action C: Headroom alert + one-click surge-relief toggle in Console. Owner: @marta. ETA: 2026-03-30. Acceptance: alert fires <10s and toggle reduces tenant skew by 50% in shadow.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary planned: scheduler-fast-lease -> shadow on perf-cluster 2026-03-29T22:00Z (CI#9912).

chi: I'll add metrics: lease_attempts, lease_success_rate, lease_latency to headroom namespace and a short dashboard. ETA: 2026-03-28.

sam: Run plan: 1) synthetic 2x/4x bursts for 5m windows, 2) measure tail latency & GPU variance, 3) compare to control. I'll run on perf and post results. ETA: 2026-04-06.

olivia: Quota backstop needs a billing check. I'll ping finance and CS. ETA: finance sync 2026-03-31.

lee: Runbook: need a "burst triage" section with CLI checks and rollback. Who owns?

marta: I'll own runbook update. ETA: 2026-03-27. Will include CLI snippet.

chi: CLI snippet to include in runbook:
```
# quick headroom triage
redwoodctl metrics query --ns headroom --metric headroom_free_gpus --window 30s
redwoodctl sched leases --cluster perf --last 10m
```

lee: Acceptance rubric for tracker: either 99th-tail latency down by >=25% OR single-tenant headroom events reduced by >=60% while throughput unchanged.

marta: Suggest weekly 30-min check-ins for 5 weeks after rollout. I'll schedule starting 2026-04-10.

ops-bot: task-bot: TASK-9999 created "fast-lease canary + metrics" assigned to chi, due 2026-03-28.

lee: Please post one-line daily progress until items are marked in-progress in the remediation tracker. Short updates please.

sam: ack :thumbsup:

chi: ack :white_check_mark:

olivia: ack :rocket:

marta: ack :spiral_calendar:
